subject: Post-call: book 60–90m ML run-through and agenda
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Amira Foley <amira@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: book 60–90m ML run-through and agenda

Hi Amira — thanks again for the call this morning. Appreciate the clarity on the workloads and the production goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary use case: near-realtime summarization and entity extraction for streaming customer chats (~200–400 tokens/request).
- Throughput: target 200 QPS during peak; 95th percentile latency target ~120ms/token.
- Data residency: some EU customer data; likely need VPC/private deployment for regulated flows.
- Success metrics: latency under SLO, predictable cost per M token, and audit logs for retention/regulatory needs.

Proposal: schedule a 60–90 minute technical run-through with our ML infra team to:
1) review architecture and model variant tradeoffs (quantization, batching, KV cache)
2) validate latency/cost targets with sample traffic profiles
3) identify any private deployment or networking requirements
4) define next steps and mutual action plan

Suggested windows (PT):
- Thu Jul 15 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu Jul 15 — 13:00–14:30 PT
- Mon Jul 19 — 09:00–10:30 PT

If none of these work, tell me two preferred slots and we’ll align. Please confirm attendees from your side (would be great if Samir or your infra lead can join).

Draft agenda attached (redwood-ml-runthrough-agenda-v1.docx). Also attaching a short pre-call checklist — if you can share the AWS account ID we’ll be using for the demo and one representative p95/p99 latency sample that would help us calibrate the environment ahead of time.

Next steps: you confirm a slot and attendees → we’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and call prep notes.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148
redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-ml-runthrough-agenda-v1.docx (docx), precall-checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Amira Foley <amira@cloudforge.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: book 60–90m ML run-through and agenda

Thanks Neha — that was helpful, and the recap matches our notes. We’d like to move forward with the run-through.

Samir (CTO) will join; I’m copying him below for calendar coordination. A couple of quick questions before we lock a slot:
- We have a mix of EU and US customers; what’s the minimum level of integration needed to validate private deployment?
- Does Redwood need access to any sample training data, or just inference traffic patterns and an AWS account for a staging setup?

Our preferred slot: Thu Jul 15 — 13:00–14:30 PT. If that’s still available, please reserve it.

Amira Foley
Head of Platform, CloudForge
amira@cloudforge.io

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@cloudforge.io>
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Amira Foley <amira@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@cloudforge.io>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: book 60–90m ML run-through and agenda

Great — Thu Jul 15 13:00–14:30 PT works. Tentative calendar invite created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-cloudforge-20270715 (we’ll send the formal invite from our calendar).

Answers to your quick questions:
- Private deployment: for an initial architecture review and sizing we only need your expected network topology (VPC/subnet patterns) and whether you require an on-prem option. To validate a private deployment end-to-end we’ll request a staging VPC and a short maintenance window to run a perf sweep; we can outline this in the mutual action plan during the run-through.
- Data access: we do NOT need production training data. For performance calibration we only need a representative inference traffic sample (latency/size distribution) and a staging AWS role/ID that has limited permissions to run inference workloads.

Pre-call asks (attach precall-checklist.pdf):
- AWS account ID / staging role name
- Representative p95/p99 latency numbers for current inference (if available)
- Any firewall/egress restrictions your networking team enforces

Marissa and Jonas from our infra team will lead the run-through. Marissa will run the architecture and performance agenda items; Jonas will cover deployment and networking. Samir — feel free to add any specifics you want us to include.

We’ve attached a short pre-call checklist to help speed setup. If any of your stakeholders prefer a different timezone, let me know — we can offer an early-morning CET-friendly slot too.

Thanks, I’ll send the calendar invite and verbatim agenda in the next message.

—
Neha

Hi all — I’ll take point on the run-through and confirmed the slot on our side. I’ll send the calendar invite from my calendar with dial-in details and an attached agenda. Short note on what I plan to cover so you can prep:

Planned run-through outline (60–90m)
- 0–10m: introductions and alignment on success criteria
- 10–25m: customer architecture review (CloudForge current infra and constraints)
- 25–45m: Redwood runtime overview + model variant tradeoffs (quantization, prefilling, KV cache behavior)
- 45–65m: perf calibration and expected latency/cost modeling for your traffic profile
- 65–80m: deployment pathways: hosted vs dedicated vs private (networking/keys/retention)
- 80–90m: action items and mutual action plan (owners + timelines)

Pre-call asks (just reiterating Neha’s list): please share the staging AWS account ID and sample inference traffic metrics if possible. If there’s anything specific you want us to demo (e.g., streaming with function calls or structured output), let me know and we’ll include a short demo segment.

Looking forward to it — I’ll send the invite and agenda now.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
